name: Pärnu
notes: Long shallow sandy beach on Pärnu Bay: flat to choppy, beginner-friendly in onshore SW winds.

name: Tallinn – Pirita
notes: City beach on Tallinn Bay: choppy, best in W–NW winds. Keep clear of swimmers in summer.

name: Tallinn – Kakumäe
notes: Shallow bay west of Tallinn, popular with local kiters; flat to choppy.
